name: LSerial
author: Niklas Sjöberg

provenance.note: Unregistered shareware build; the binary emits 'UNREGISTERED SHAREWARE version of LSerial!' banners. Attributed to Niklas Sjoberg, the LDos author — inferred here from the shared naming and demo layout, and since confirmed by the Ultimate Amiga AMOS Factory archive listing.
provenance.redistribution: Third-party extension, redistribution terms unverified. The AMOS PD Library on CD (Weird Science, 1994), archive.org item cdrom-amospdcd. The disc's own Documents/Copyrights states Weird Science claims no copyright over the material, that parts are shareware with fees due, and that users should make no assumption that anything on it is public domain. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

notes: Serial port keywords (Lser Open/Close/Send/Read/Query). Explains all 8 ids observed in slot 11, so the id base is calibrated. Documented, so manual tier. Like IOPorts, the keyword surface is portable but serial.device has no counterpart here. Andrew Burton's AMOS Extensions List (kept at ultimateamiga.com, updated 2007-07-29), compiled from the AMOS-LIST archives 1994-1998, Amiga magazine clippings and coverdisk CDs. records a later 2.2.
